title.narrative: EG-Strengthening the Capacity of SIOIRAFI in project coordination, Monitoring & Supervision

description.narrative: Strengthening the capacity of the Ministry of International Cooperation (MoIC), in partcular, the Sector for International Organizations, International, Regional and Arab Financing Institutions (SIOIRAFI), in the areas of project management, coordination, monitoring and supervision. The main objective of the IDF grant is to strengthen the capacity of the Sector for International Organizations, International, Regional, and Arab Financing Institutions (SIOIRAFI) under the Ministry of International Cooperation (MoIC), in the areas of project coordination, monitoring and supervision. The proposed IDF grant will not only strengthen the capacity of SIOIRAFI's staff in the areas indicated above, it will also enhance the knowledge of staff on Management Information System (MIS), which will ultimately improve the quality, timeliness and flow of work /information within the SIOIRAFI and between SIOIRAFI and other key Ministries, including its parent Ministry (MoIC). These will be achieved through series of training/capacity building on project management (project coordination, monitoring and supervision) and on MIS. To accomplish the training on MIS, the grant will finance computer equipment (including printers and relevant accessories). The strengthened capacity and improved MIS will allow SIOIRAFI to effectively work on project data/information, monitor and follow up on status and results of projects for informed policy decisions. supervision) and on MIS.
